about: A Shot's time to first drip and whether it is Unfinished, case by case (#609, timeToFirstDrip in protocol/src/record-samples.ts). Each case gives its Preheat's samples and then its profile's, each [seconds from the start of the profile, the scale's weight in grams or null where it read nothing]; the profile's first sample is at 0 s. poured is whether the Machine reported pouring. firstDrip is the time to first drip in seconds, or null where it has none; unfinished is whether it is an Unfinished Shot, nothing poured: not poured, and no time to first drip. Other ports of the rule, such as the cafe skin's, test these same cases.

cases.name: a weight that creeps from 0.1 g to 1 g over several seconds drips at its first reading of 0.2 g or more
a reading of 0.2 g or more that returns to zero before the rise is not the first drip
a reading of 0.1 g that comes and goes 5 s before the rise is not the first drip
a reading under zero counts as zero
a sample with no scale reading is passed over, and is not a zero
the first drip comes within the first 2 s where the scale keeps rising, as on a fast Shot
a scale that never reads 1 g has no time to first drip, whatever smaller readings it has; poured, it is not Unfinished
a scale that never reads 1 g, where nothing poured, is Unfinished
a Shot with no scale has no time to first drip, and is Unfinished where it never poured
a Shot with no scale that poured is not Unfinished
no reading in Preheat counts, as none there is the Shot's weight
a cup weighed before the tare landed is left out, and the first drip is in the rise after the tare
a cup weighed before the tare landed, where nothing poured, is Unfinished
a reading of 1 g within the first 2 s that falls under it there is taken for a cup weighed before the tare
a cup on the scale throughout, in full gateway mode, which never tares, reads as recorded: its first reading
known limit: a scale that settles a little under 1 g within the first second reads as a first drip then
known limit: a scale tared again partway has its first drip in the rise after that zero
